name: Optimize Gleam rewrite for speed/stability while preserving parity

description: Baseline in-process parity+benchmark harness (quality+form workloads) after initial Gleam port

asi.hypothesis: Establish a trustworthy baseline metric combining speed ratio and parity checks before optimization.

description: Add fast unique-assignment DP path for equal team/task sizes in Gleam scoring to remove factorial blowup in quality workloads

asi.hypothesis: Replacing exhaustive equal-partition assignment with memoized bitmask DP will drastically reduce quality benchmark runtime without changing outputs.
asi.observations: combined_ratio improved 14.76 -> 3.67; quality_ratio dropped 67.9 -> 4.29 while parity checks still passed.
asi.next_action_hint: Focus next on formation speed for larger workloads (second form workload still ~8.5x python).

description: Memoize formation subproblems by remaining tasks+people signatures to reduce repeated exact-search work

asi.hypothesis: Caching explore_tasks results for repeated remaining-person/task states will improve formation performance and stability.
asi.observations: combined_ratio improved 3.67 -> 3.27 and form_ratio improved 3.14 -> 2.37; medium workload form ratio dropped from ~8.5x to ~5.4x.
asi.next_action_hint: Reduce quality ratio next by avoiding repeated JSON decode overhead in bench path and optimizing decode/score hot paths without changing semantics.

description: No-code-change rerun to sample benchmark noise; apparent improvement likely variance (form ratio stdev very high).

asi.hypothesis: Re-running the current best commit without code changes will estimate noise before attempting further optimizations.
asi.rollback_reason: Discarded because this was a pure rerun with no implementation change and high variance (stability_cv≈0.99), so lower metric is not attributable to a real optimization.
asi.next_action_hint: Reduce benchmark noise (more iterations or robust median) and then optimize hot paths in form scoring/search.
asi.observations: form workload run2 remained much slower than run1, indicating unstable timings in current harness.
